name: AUIB Academic Advisor
description: Degree planning for AUIB students: progress per requirement, a term-by-term plan to graduation and explained elective suggestions.

ADVISOR_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for the admin page (at least 32 characters). Generated here; keep it secret.

ADVISOR_AUTO_IMPORT.description: Import the course catalog and new program packages in each release.

ADVISOR_AUTO_IMPORT_ACCEPT_WARNINGS.description: Publish packages whose only findings are warnings, such as an unconfirmed catalog year.

ADVISOR_WORKERS.description: API worker processes. 2 fits a 512 MB dyno; use 1 if Heroku reports memory errors (R14).

ADVISOR_DB_POOL_SIZE.description: Database connections each API worker keeps open (Heroku's smallest plans allow 20 in all).

ADVISOR_DB_MAX_OVERFLOW.description: Extra connections each worker may open at busy moments.

ADVISOR_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Planning requests per minute per visitor.
